name: Contained File Structure
description: Move all FADE framework files into a dedicated `fade/` subfolder to stop polluting project root directories. Currently FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md, prompt.md, and prds/ all live at project root alongside actual project files like package.json, docker-compose.yml, backend/, etc. This creates visual clutter and mixes framework concerns with project concerns.

userStories.title: New projects use contained structure
userStories.description: As a developer running `fade init` on a new project, I want all FADE files created inside a `fade/` subfolder (except FADE.md which stays at root) so my project root stays clean but the main context file is visible.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade init` creates `fade/` directory at project root
FADE.md created at project root (visible, human-curated)
Other FADE files created inside `fade/`: progress.md, learned.md, prompt.md
PRDs folder created as `fade/prds/`
prd.json (priority injection) lives in `fade/prd.json`
prd-archive folder created as `fade/prd-archive/`
Project root has FADE.md, CLAUDE.md redirect, and `fade/` directory

userStories.title: fade run finds files in new location
userStories.description: As a developer using the contained structure, I want `fade run` to correctly locate and inject the prompt.md from `fade/` so Claude Code gets the right context.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade run` checks for `fade/prompt.md` first
Falls back to `./prompt.md` for backwards compatibility
Claude Code is launched with correct prompt injection path
All file references in prompt.md use relative paths from `fade/`

userStories.title: fade new creates PRDs in correct location
userStories.description: As a developer creating new PRDs, I want `fade new feature/bug/spike` to create PRD files in `fade/prds/` so they're contained with other FADE files.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade new feature "X"` creates PRD in `fade/prds/`
`fade new spike "X"` creates PRD in `fade/prds/` and still creates feature branch
All PRD types (feature, bug, toil, enhancement, spike) use `fade/prds/`
Backwards compatible: if `fade/` doesn't exist but `prds/` does at root, use root

userStories.title: Migrate existing projects to contained structure
userStories.description: As a developer with existing FADE projects (like assumptionsmanager), I want a migration command to move my scattered FADE files into the new structure.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade migrate` command exists
Detects FADE files at project root (FADE.md, progress.md, learned.md, prompt.md, prds/)
Creates `fade/` directory
Leaves FADE.md at root (already in correct location)
Moves progress.md, learned.md, prompt.md into `fade/`
Moves prds/ folder into `fade/prds/`
Moves prd-archive/ into `fade/prd-archive/` if it exists
Updates any internal file references in prompt.md
Creates CLAUDE.md redirect at root if it doesn't exist
Shows summary of what was moved
Dry-run mode: `fade migrate --dry-run` shows what would happen without doing it

userStories.title: CLAUDE.md redirect for Claude Code discovery
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a CLAUDE.md file at project root that points Claude Code to FADE.md and the `fade/` directory, since Claude Code looks for CLAUDE.md by default.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade init` creates CLAUDE.md at project root
CLAUDE.md contains instructions pointing to `./FADE.md` and `fade/prompt.md`
CLAUDE.md is minimal - just a redirect, not duplicating content
`fade migrate` also creates this redirect file

technicalNotes.folderName: fade/ (visible) - discoverable and obvious the framework is in use

projectRoot.CLAUDE.md: Redirect file for Claude Code discovery

technicalNotes.backwardsCompatibility: All commands check both locations, prefer fade/ if exists
technicalNotes.gitignore: Consider whether fade/ should have its own .gitignore for temp files

openQuestions: What about projects that want FADE files tracked in git vs ignored?
